enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn head to left. Turn head to right. Move right arm. Move left arm. Bend right knee. Bend left knee. Straighten legs. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Hug pillow. Stretch arms. Yawn. Turn to back. Move legs. Breathe deeply.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Turn off tap. Take off pajamas. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bread. Take out plate. Place bread on plate. Take out knife. Spread butter on bread. Open refrigerator. Take out jam. Spread jam on bread. Close refrigerator. Pick up plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat bread. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Pack laptop. Pack phone.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand and wait. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Listen to music. Check phone. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to hospital.

Arrive at hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurses' station. Pick up patient charts. Review notes. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update chart. Walk to next patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update chart. Walk to cafeteria. Buy lunch. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend meeting.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Cook. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in air-conditioned room, watching TV and using personal computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on air conditioner. Adjust temperature. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Change channels. Sit on bed. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Type. Browse internet. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off computer. Turn off air conditioner.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Hug pillow. Stretch arms. Yawn. Turn to back. Breathe deeply.
